slices.focus: Berth near-miss makes only board-matched digital count as official.
slices.summary: A near-operational mess from conflicting berth times pushed Jae-hyun to make the board-matched digital template the sole official handoff record: side calls, verbal updates, and remembered conversations no longer count. An older dispatcher who called captains directly from memory was the trigger. Jae-hyun endures weeks of unpopularity but persists, repeating 'enter it so everyone can use it' and keeping a private mismatch log.
